product_overview: E-JUST Anyplace is a recovered indoor mapping and navigation API for controlled local or staging environments. It supports public version and map discovery endpoints, local account authentication, protected mapping writes, and indoor route calculation for web and Android clients.
core_goals: Expose a public version endpoint and viewer redirect for unauthenticated access
Support local user registration, login, and token refresh for controlled staging accounts
Provide public discovery of mapping spaces and buildings for viewer/mobile clients
Enforce authorization on mapping write operations
Return indoor navigation routes from controlled mapping data without leaking sensitive information

features.name: Version and Viewer routing
features.description: Provides a public version endpoint and redirects unknown browser GET routes to the Viewer application.
user_flows: GET /api/version -> Receive 200 with JSON version object and server metadata -> Verify response does not expose secrets
GET /some/unknown/browser-route -> Receive 303 redirect to /viewer -> Follow redirect to /viewer in browser
GET /api/version with backend unavailable -> Receive non-200 error response indicating service failure

features.name: Local account authentication
features.description: Allows controlled local self-registration, local login, and access-token refresh for staging accounts.
user_flows: POST /api/user/register with valid name, email, username, and password -> Receive 200 with registration status and new-user object -> Confirm plaintext password is not included in response

POST /api/user/login/local with valid username and password -> Receive 200 with user object and local access token -> POST /api/user/refresh with access_token -> Receive 200 with refreshed user object without plaintext password
POST /api/user/register with missing required fields -> Receive 400 with validation error
POST /api/user/login/local with invalid credentials -> Receive 400 with authentication error without sensitive details
POST /api/user/refresh with missing or invalid access_token -> Receive 400 with token error

features.name: Public mapping discovery
features.description: Returns public spaces and building data for viewer and mobile clients, including valid empty results during recovery.
user_flows: POST /api/mapping/space/public with empty JSON object -> Receive 200 with JSON object containing spaces and buildings arrays -> Use returned public mapping data in viewer/mobile client
POST /api/mapping/space/public with malformed request body -> Receive non-200 or validation error response
POST /api/mapping/space/public against an empty staging database -> Receive 200 with empty spaces and buildings arrays

features.name: Protected mapping writes
features.description: Creates mapping spaces and other protected mapping data only for authorized accounts.
user_flows: POST /api/user/login/local with valid credentials -> Receive 200 with local access token -> POST /api/mapping/space/add with valid mapping-space JSON and authorization -> Receive 200 confirming created mapping space
POST /api/mapping/space/add without authorization -> Receive 401 missing or invalid authorization
POST /api/mapping/space/add with invalid or expired authorization -> Receive 401 unauthorized response
POST /api/mapping/space/add with malformed mapping-space JSON -> Receive validation error response

features.name: Indoor navigation
features.description: Calculates indoor routes from supplied navigation data when controlled floor and POI data exists.
user_flows: POST /api/navigation/route with valid navigation route request JSON -> Receive 200 with navigation route JSON -> Use route data for client guidance
POST /api/navigation/route with invalid navigation request JSON -> Receive 400 invalid navigation request
POST /api/navigation/route against missing controlled floor or POI data -> Receive non-200 error or empty/failed route response appropriate to available data

features.description: Provides an unauthenticated version endpoint and redirects unknown browser GET routes to Viewer.

endpoints.description: Registers a local account from name, email, username, and password.

response_schema.200: Registration status and new-user object without plaintext password
response_schema.400: Missing field or duplicate identity error

endpoints.description: Authenticates a local account with username and password.

response_schema.200: User object with local access token

endpoints.description: Refreshes a local session using an access token.

features.name: Public mapping discovery
features.description: Lists public spaces and related mapping data for Viewer and mobile clients.

endpoints.description: Returns public spaces and buildings; an empty dataset is valid during recovery.

response_schema.200: JSON object containing spaces and buildings arrays

features.name: Protected mapping writes
features.description: Requires authorization for mapping changes such as creating spaces, floors, POIs, and connections.
